::: {#def-vision-transformer}

#### Vision Transformer (ViT)

A **vision Transformer**,
or **ViT**,
cuts an image into square patches,
maps each patch to a vector with one linear layer,
adds a learned [positional encoding](attention-transformers.qmd#def-positional-encoding),
and passes the sequence through [Transformer block](attention-transformers.qmd#def-transformer-block)s [@dosovitskiy2021image, section 3.1].
A classifier then reads one vector summarizing the sequence.

:::
